caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure positioned on a rectangular, stepped base that is colored green. The statue itself is rendered in brownish-red tones with details clearly defined. The figure is adorned with a large headdress, necklaces, and a garment that appears to be a fringed skirt along with a draped cloak over one shoulder. The figure's right hand rests at the waist, holding a rectangular object against the body, while the left hand is placed higher up on the chest, gripping part of the cloak. The statue has detailed facial features and is decorated with symmetrical, starburst-like motifs on the knees. The background of the drawing is an off-white or beige color and remains blank without any detail or objects other than the prominently featured statue and its base.
